description_expanded: OverviewWatercolor - 29 Silk CHThe Space29 Silk Grass Lane is the perfect getaway for two! This beautiful 1 bedroom carriage house in Watercolor is quietly tucked in beside the main house with easy access to the beach, nearby Frog pool and WaterColor`s Boat House. This carriage house includes a washer and dryer and all of the comforts of home making it a favorite place to stay for couples.***Watercolor does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. All carts must be reserved through their exclusive vendor Electric Cart Company******Beach Chair Rentals available through Watercolor Beach Service www.watercolorresort.com/beachsetups. Book Early!******Watercolor Amenities***A total of 4 wristbands are allowed for this property. Watercolor requires 1 wristband per person.Children under the age of 5 do not need a wristband. The wristbands will be located inside the property.Please note that when the Carriage House and Main House are rented together the max wristbands allowed will be 14.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 4)- 1 King sized bed- 1 Queen Sleeper SofaHOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 5 min walk to Camp Watercolor- 5 Min bike ride to the beach- 2 Adult Bikes ProvidedShow less
